name: lumiverse-auto-retry
description: Watches each reply as it comes in and retries it when something goes wrong: an error, an empty reply, a stream that stalls, a reply cut off mid-sentence, or a refusal. Every check, phrase and retry note can be read and changed in its settings.
author: starlitcode

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:frontend && bun run typecheck:backend
scripts.build: bun run build:frontend && bun run build:backend
